input.summary: Remove the one-sided "only" exculpation in Section 6.2(a) and confirm the Servicer's/Marketing Agent's specific obligations (deposit, acquisition and indemnity) sit outside any liability limitation.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 6.2(a) limits Cellco's liability to willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence, while the mirror provision for the Depositor (Section 5.2(a)) contains no such "only" — so we have deleted "only" to restore mutuality. We have also confirmed that the Servicer's and Marketing Agent's specific obligations, including the Servicer Deposit Obligation, the Servicer Acquisition Obligation, remittance of Collections and the Section 6.3 indemnities, sit outside any limitation on liability, consistent with our position that indemnification and core performance obligations are never capped; we are not proposing a fees-based cap, which would be illusory here.

ops.oldText: Each of the Servicer and the Marketing Agent, severally and not jointly, will be liable only for its own willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence in performing its obligations under this Agreement.
ops.newText: Each of the Servicer and the Marketing Agent, severally and not jointly, will be liable for its own willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence in performing its obligations under this Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, nothing in this Section 6.2 will limit, waive or release the liability of the Servicer or the Marketing Agent for the performance of its specific obligations under this Agreement and the other Transaction Documents, including the Servicer Deposit Obligation, the Servicer Acquisition Obligation, its obligations to deposit or remit Collections and its indemnification obligations under Section 6.3, none of which will be subject to any limitation or cap on liability.
